svg.text: the court, the tent and its furnishings, to scale
a cubit is about 18 inches, 45 cm

g.text: the camp round it is not to scale
with the mercy seat and cherubim
hammered from one talent of pure gold
standing acacia frames, in silver bases
blue, purple, scarlet · linen · goats' hair
rams' skins · sea cow hides · acacia
fine linen — blue, purple, and scarlet
